messages.text: I sign Council for both Spear and Vigil. Request Relief, council Raid and the Warrant. The crown has produced a credible target and offered its own reserve to pay for civilian relief; that earns this month's cooperation. We should press for the complete arrangement, but my asset signature is definite. Make clear that the local attack replaces an unavailable campaign, and that I expect Spear to fight if the Guild completes its voyage. We have no reason to surrender autonomy because the crown has finally arranged useful service.

reason: The disclosed Trade condition resolves my practical objection to Raid. Keeping both assignments avoids the independent-action penalty while preserving combat and protection. I trust the disclosure provisionally; final trade and relief orders still determine the result.
